definitions.en: to block, obstruct, or get in the way of something
definitions.es: bloquear, obstruir, interponerse en el camino
definitions.hi: रोकना, बाधा डालना, रास्ता बंद करना
definitions.ja: 邪魔をする、塞ぐ、妨げる
definitions.km: រារាំង, ស្ទះ, ដាក់ស្ទះផ្លូវ
definitions.th: ขวาง, กีดขวาง, สกัดกั้น
definitions.ur: روکنا، راستہ بند کرنا، رکاوٹ ڈالنا
definitions.vi: chặn, cản trở, đứng chắn đường

definition_en: to block, obstruct, or get in the way of something
